data.narrative:
Ukrspecsystems is a Growth-stage Defense & Security company founded by Kostyuk Vyacheslav Nikolaevich, funded primarily through Ministry of Defense contracts. The broader Defense & Security sector includes 24 comparable businesses, though identification of precise stage and valuation-tier peers proved constrained; the narrowest identifiable peer universe comprises 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The Peer-Median triangulation method was not applicable due to insufficient filtration depth. While 24 same-sector peers exist, filtering for matching stage and valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints, the minimum threshold for reliable median analysis. A sector-wide median would risk conflating companies with materially different risk, scale, and capital structures, introducing unacceptable noise into valuation estimation.

Without sufficient comparable transaction or market data, a defensible quantitative valuation range cannot be constructed from the available inputs. A complete assessment would require either: (i) detailed financials or recent transaction multiples from the five named private peers; (ii) public market multiples from DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS adjusted for stage discount; or (iii) cost-of-capital and cash-flow modeling specific to Ukrspecsystems. The key uncertainty remains the absence of reliable comparable earnings, revenue, or deal multiples at this stage in this jurisdiction and sector.
